data_contract.neural: Actual sub-001 read-info declares 189 channels × 396000 samples, double precision, big-endian .dat; matching *_meg.json, channels and sensor transforms present in ZIP index.
data_contract.labels: Actual events.tsv columns onset,duration,sample,type,value; author loader uses Start_index/Start_pinky. Subject metadata sub_info.mat and sub_info_adults.mat provided in code.
data_contract.time_alignment: Sample-indexed triggers; acquisition JSON supplies SamplingFrequency. Use index/pinky same preprocessing and equal trial counts.
data_contract.split: Reproduction uses original cohort; extension participant-held-out, age-stratified, no windows from one child across splits.
data_contract.controls: Motion/head-size/retained-trial covariates, matched trial counts, event-shift surrogate preserving autocorrelation; subject-level uncertainty.
